grid_factor_source.scope: Scope2 location-based generated electricity factor for purchased kWh; no export credit; T&D/WTT excluded

basis: Real2026GBP, costs atyear-end, initial cash atyear0; repeated2025 physical year, no escalation/tax/subsidy/VOLL; no equipment residual, recover unchanged fuel stock atyear20

cost_scope.BESS: 400GBP/kWh interpreted as DC battery/racks/BMS only; excludes standalone PCS. Explicit unverified boundary assumption, not proof of a packaged quote.
cost_scope.PCS: 250GBP/kW separate90kW BESS PCS; no additional inverter counted inside BESS cost
cost_scope.PV: 1257GBP/kWp PV assembly including PV inverter, excluding common site allowance; illustrative scope assumption
cost_scope.wind: 4000GBP/kW turbine/conversion assembly, excluding common site allowance; illustrative scope assumption
cost_scope.common_installation: 60000GBP same site/civils/switchgear allowance for P0R and hybrids; no duplicate separate civils/inverter rows
cost_scope.capital: CAPEX excludes initial diesel working inventory; year0 cash includes both. No equipment salvage atyear20 is a conservative financial assumption.
cost_scope.replacement: Inherited year12 BESS70%/PCS70%/UPS65%; year15 DG80%. No within20year PV/wind replacement assumed; not OEM lifetime certification.
